Definition: Tiglath-Pileser or Tilgath-pilneser, an Assyryrian king
BiblicalUsage: Tiglath-pileser or Tilgath-pilneser = "thou will uncover the wonderful bond"; 1) an Assyrian king who attacked Samaria or northern kingdom of Israel in the reign of Pekah
